executiveSummary: Inspection of Example Conveyancing Co Ltd identifies seven non-compliant findings on a single £875,000 purchase matter. The most serious issues concern borrower identity, source-of-funds evidence for a third-party gift, enhanced due diligence, MLRO procedure, unresolved source-of-funds schedule gaps, bank-statement coverage, and firm AML policy wording that accepts older address evidence than CLC guidance allows. The file also contains clear compliant evidence for estate distribution funds, lender disclosure, costs information, and complaints information. One good-practice finding is noted because the source-of-funds schedule clearly records supported, partial, and outstanding evidence streams.
